## Observed CI gap, not a functional regression

At PR #188 head `2ed0e24c866a2b7c723cda7927ad3765e24e4cef`, the Node 26 job fails the unchanged branch-coverage gate after **537/537 functional tests pass in both the npm and Bun invocations**.

Source job: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-beads/actions/runs/40760622195/job/123071234214

The Bun invocation reports:
- aggregate branch coverage **99.96%**, below the required 100%;
- `index.ts` branch coverage **99.87%**;
- diagnostic `index.ts:1855 uncovered branch BRDA:1855,518,0,0`.

The source at that location is the nonzero-exit error fallback:
https://github.com/unbraind/pm-beads/blob/2ed0e24c866a2b7c723cda7927ad3765e24e4cef/index.ts#L1851-L1855

```ts
if (result.status !== 0) {
  throw new CommandError(result.stderr || "pm list failed");
}
```

The npm invocation passes its gate, Node 22 succeeds, and the new `repair.ts` module is 100% covered. Therefore this report does **not** establish a repair runtime failure, a data-loss defect, or that the new feature introduced the underlying coverage instability. The reason the two invocations cover different branches is not yet established.

## Expected contract and impact

The canonical feature record explicitly requires the full npm and Bun release gates at unchanged thresholds:
https://github.com/unbraind/pm-beads/blob/2ed0e24c866a2b7c723cda7927ad3765e24e4cef/.agents/pm/features/pm-beads-y6cp.toon

The current exact-head Node 26 gate is red despite all functional tests passing, blocking the required verification evidence. Keep the 100% threshold rather than lowering it or treating passing test counts as a full gate pass.

## Reproduction/evidence

Use the PR's existing CI sequence on the immutable head above. The npm release check completes; the subsequent Bun release check reaches its coverage phase and fails at the shown branch. Full job logs preserve both invocations and the uncovered-branch diagnostic. This was observed in hosted CI; a complete local Node 26 gate reproduction is not claimed.

Independent isolated Node 24 checks of the new repair functions passed, but are not evidence that this separate full-gate coverage condition is resolved.

## Acceptance / regression criteria

- Deterministically exercise nonzero `readPmItemsViaSpawn` status with nonempty stderr and with empty stderr, asserting the original stderr and the `pm list failed` fallback respectively.
- Make the branch coverage independent of incidental child-process warnings or prior invocation state.
- Re-run exact-head npm and Bun release gates on Node 22 and 26 with the existing 100% thresholds; retain receipts for both invocations.
- Preserve fail-closed workspace reads and typed command errors. Do not suppress the fallback or weaken the gate merely to pass.

All-status issue/PR records and the feature record were checked before filing; old #75 is closed general coverage work. This is distinct from daily release publication failures. No provider mutation, published-artifact failure, or deployment claim is made.
Node 26 Bun gate misses nonzero CLI stderr fallback branch despite passing tests
